description: This file defines the 'WorkShift' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the 'ohrm_work_shift' database table. It includes properties for shift ID, name, hours per day, start time, and end time, along with getter and setter methods, and utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping. The class also employs a decorator trait for additional functionality.

classes.name: WorkShift
classes.description: Entity class representing a work shift in the HRM system, mapped to the 'ohrm_work_shift' table with properties for shift details and timings.
